instruction: GENERATE ONE IMAGE NOW. Output only the finished image, with no text, no explanation and no rewritten prompt. Follow this JSON specification exactly.
image_type: photorealistic phone-camera selfie portrait, front camera, candid fashion-editorial look, no filters beyond a soft warm tone

reference_images.image_1: pose, framing, lighting and composition reference (selfie holding a plush toy over the lower face); copy the pose and framing, do NOT copy the person, hair color, hat or clothes
reference_images.image_2: the Clawd mascot: use it as the exact design of the plush toy in her hand
reference_images.image_3: the orange ushanka hat design to reproduce on her head

camera.type: smartphone front camera, wide ~24mm equivalent, arm's length selfie
camera.angle: camera slightly above eye level, a few degrees of downward tilt, lens centered on her eyes
camera.framing: head and hat fill the top 45 percent of the frame; chest and necklaces visible in the bottom 30 percent; her left hand holding the plush enters from the lower-left edge; slight phone-lens perspective distortion
camera.focus: sharp on the eyes and the plush, very soft falloff at the edges

subject.ethnicity_skin: young white woman, fair skin with warm pink undertones, natural texture with visible pores, a few softly drawn faux freckles across the nose and cheekbones
subject.face: narrow oval face, defined but soft cheekbones, big doll-like dark brown eyes with long curled lashes and extra lower lashes drawn on like manga lashes, straight natural eyebrows
subject.makeup: warm brown bronzer smudged in a band across the nose bridge and cheekbones like in image 1, light pink blush, faint freckles, glossy lips (mostly hidden by the plush)
subject.expression: calm, cute and slightly mischievous; eyes looking straight into the lens, eyebrows relaxed, mouth completely hidden behind the plush toy
subject.head_pose: head straight and facing the camera, tilted a few degrees to her left

hair.length: long, falling past the shoulders and chest on both sides
hair.style: blunt full bangs cut straight across the eyebrows, hair tucked behind nothing, falls forward over the shoulders; a few fine flyaways catching the light; no blue, no pink

headwear.design: the orange fluffy faux-fur ushanka from image 3 with fur ear flaps; worn level and low across the forehead so it sits just above the bangs, with a glossy inflated vinyl Clawd badge centered on the front of the crown
headwear.badge: blocky pixel-art mascot badge, terracotta orange #D97757, two small black square eyes, two stubby side arms, four short legs
headwear.note: the hat replaces the lilac beret of image 1; the ear flaps hang beside her face behind the hair

held_object.item: a small plush toy of the Clawd mascot (image 2), about 14 cm wide
held_object.design: soft terracotta-orange #D97757 velour plush, blocky pixel-art body, two small black square button eyes, two stubby side arms, four short square legs hanging at the bottom, tiny stitched seams, slightly squishy
held_object.how_held: held by her left hand (on the left of the frame) pressed up against her chin and mouth, covering the lower half of her face from nose to chin, tilted a few degrees, the legs dangling over her necklaces; her thumb on the front edge and fingers wrapped behind it
held_object.hand: slender hand with long almond-shaped pale pink gel nails, two thin silver rings; natural knuckles and skin creases, exactly five fingers

clothing.top: black fuzzy mohair-knit short-sleeve top with a pale lavender and magenta knitted pattern around the neckline, as in image 1
jewelry: long strand of grey-silver pearls hanging to the chest
a silver ornate heart-shaped locket pendant with a violet center
a small chain with a tiny star charm

background.setting: a plain indoor wall and ceiling corner, warm cream / pale butter-yellow wall, slightly out of focus
background.details: soft vertical shadow on the right, no objects, no windows

lighting.type: soft warm window light mixed with indoor ambient light, no harsh flash
lighting.color_temperature: warm, around 4200K, creamy highlights, slightly lifted shadows
lighting.skin: luminous and soft, subtle shine on the forehead and nose

mood: cozy, kawaii-meets-alt, intimate, phone-selfie authenticity, scroll-stopping
quality: high resolution, crisp detail on eyelashes, plush fabric fibers and hat fur; natural skin; realistic hands
negative_prompt: do not copy the face or hair color of image 1
no Sanrio / My Melody character, the toy must be Clawd
